balls.text: hard length, slanting into middle and leg. Gleeson is late on the pull and the ball pings off the thigh pad into the off side. Just a leg bye to end the innings
low full toss on middle and off, bowled from around the wicket. Gleeson pushes it towards long off and Deshpande tears back for the second, making it at the danger end

miscued, and taken by Curran running in! Banged into the track outside off. Jadeja has to fetch it and does not manage to do so. Slices it straight up, and Curran tracks it all the way from long on. Completes the catch just a little outside the ring, and CSK lose their ninth!
right out of the screws! Slower ball in the slot outside off. Jadeja picks it, plants his front foot and wallops it over wide long on!
full and wide outside off. Beyond the tramlines and some more exercise for the umpire
dug into the track outside off. Jadeja stands up on his toes and slaps it past the bowler. Gets two by the time Bairstow mops up at long off
Jadeja starts the over with a boundary! Full toss on the pads and that is a loose delivery. Jadeja uses the angle and swings it away past short fine leg!
full on the stumps. Deshpande digs it out towards mid off. Dot to end the over, and the 19th has yielded just two runs
an anti-climax! Sprays this well outside off. Perhaps a wide yorker that went wrong. The umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide

and Harshal cleans up Dhoni first ball! A superb slower yorker that drops on Dhoni late and does him all ends up. He does not pick the variation and like Shardul, is early into the stroke. The ball sneaks under the toe-end, and then thunders into the stumps. The CSK fans at the venue cannot quite believe what has happened, and their day goes from bad to worse!

knocks him over! Another slower yorker, and this is on the stumps. Finishes on middle and off, and Shardul, trying to muscle it down the ground, is early into the stroke. Breezes past the bat and smashes into the stumps. And the crowd now finds its voice because MS Dhoni is walking out to the middle!
another beautifully-executed slower yorker outside off. Dips on Shardul late and squirms underneath his swinging bat
slower yorker just outside off. Shardul aims for the moon and swings a week too early. Gets nowhere close to it in the end. Jadeja tried to sneak in a bye but Jitesh was alert to it
yorker speared in on the toes. Jadeja, despite advancing, can only drive it straight to long on

This is a little fuller outside off. This grips in the surface too and spins considerably, going past Shardul's flailing blade. The third umpire has been called into question to check for a possible stumping but Shardul's back foot was well behind the crease!
back of a length outside off. Shardul has a huge swing at it and misses
short and way outside off. Some more exercise for the umpire
shortish just outside off. Skids onto Jadeja and he is rushed on the pull. Just a single to deep mid wicket
Jadeja joins in on the fun now! Slowed up but this is right in the slot outside off. Jadeja gets down on one knee and whacks it over deep mid wicket!
fired in quicker on a length on leg stump. Shardul swings it away towards deep mid wicket. Might have come off the toe-end
shot! Marginally short outside off. Shardul picks up the length early, establishes a solid base and bashes it between long off and deep cover!
off-pace and hung up well outside off. Shardul fetches it and drags it towards long on
slower bumper outside off. Jadeja gets onto the back foot and pulls it towards deep square leg
another cutter, on a back of a length on middle and off. Shardul continues swinging and cloths it towards deep mid wicket

pushed over the fence! Slower ball on a length on leg stump. Shardul cannot free his arms fully and tugs at it. Chips it towards Shashank at deep mid wicket, who, after being well inside the fence, has to back-track. In that motion, he parries it over the fence!
oh, hello! Length on middle and off. Shardul does not move his feet much but gets on top of the bounce, cracking it past the bowler with a straight bat!
full on the pads. Jadeja tucks it off his toes towards deep mid wicket

holes out to long on! Dangles the carrot outside off and Santner bites. Tries to smash this over long on but has to reach out, meaning that he clinks it off the toe-end. Does not get the requisite power to clear Bairstow, and he takes a simple catch on the fence!
fired in on a length on leg stump. Jadeja goes back and tucks it off his pads towards deep square leg
floated up fuller on middle and off. Santner has a huge swing at it but shanks it towards deep square leg
short and wide outside off. Jadeja sits back in his crease and flat-bats it towards extra cover. The fielder dives to his right and saves three
full on off. Santner pokes it towards extra cover and scampers across to the other end
dropped short outside off. Jadeja hops back and swipes it towards deep mid wicket
slower bumper on middle and off. Takes an age to arrive and when it does, Jadeja pulls it towards deep square leg
cutter on a back of a length outside off. Santner stays on top of the bounce and punches it towards deep cover point
fuller on middle and leg. Jadeja flicks it towards deep mid wicket. He wanted the second but it was never on
back of a length on middle and off. Santner hops up onto his toes and works it towards deep mid wicket
Santner breaks free! Shortish on leg stump. Santner picks the line and the length early, steps inside the line and helps it over short fine leg!
hard length on middle and off. Santner can only prod it back towards the bowler
full outside off. Santner comes forward and knocks it to long off
banged into the track on middle and leg. Santner ducks under it. Might have been a slower bouncer
cutter on a full length outside off. Jadeja leans into the drive and drives it crisply past extra cover. Deep point runs around, reins it in but not before CSK get three
full outside off. Jadeja drills it back at the bowler, who bends down to his right and gets a good hand to it
back of a length on leg stump. Santner glances it towards short fine leg, who dives to his right and keeps it to a single
slower ball on a full length outside off. Jadeja comes forward and drives it to long off
another back-of-the-hand slower ball outside off. Jadeja waits for it and punches it towards deep cover point
short outside off. Santner gets up on his toes and pushes it towards deep cover point to get off the mark

goes straight up, and Moeen perishes! Slower bumper outside off. Moeen tries to swipe it into next week but does not come to grips with the variation. The ball gets big on him and it skews off the top edge. Spoons up to Bairstow at short fine leg, who makes no mistake. CSK slide further!
another slower ball, on a hard length on middle and leg. Jadeja chops it into the off side and Moeen is alert enough to sneak in a single
length just outside off. Moeen has a swish at it and shanks it down the ground towards long on
cutter on a length outside off. Moeen jabs it towards extra cover
shorter outside off. Moeen rolls his wrists over it and guides it down to third man

gets it through! Back of a length outside off. Moeen gets on top of the bounce and steers it towards backward point, who gets a hand to it. Third man has a go at it too but he also only manages to parry it into the fence!
hard length just outside off. This skids off the surface and Moeen, looking for the pull, is beaten for pace
freebie, and put away by Moeen! Full toss on off and that is fodder for Moeen. Snaps his wrists into it and whips it over mid wicket!
back of a length just outside off. Might have been a slower one and it just gripped in the surface before squirming past the outside edge
full on the pads. Moeen presses forward and flicks it straight to short mid wicket
four more! Slower ball on a length outside off. Jadeja dabs it towards Brar at backward point, who makes a complete mess of it. Goes through his legs, and Jadeja picks up another boundary!
just enough on this! Slot ball just outside off. Jadeja tries to go over mid off again. Clinks it off the bottom part of the bat, but gets enough wood to clear mid off!
length outside off. Moeen goes feeling for it and gets an outside edge that dribbles down to third man

safe! Full, angling into the stumps. Jadeja skips down the track and tries to go over mid off. The bat face closes upon impact and he shanks it. Fortunately for him, it lands just in front of Curran at long on
into the blockhole outside off. Moeen opens his bat face and guides it towards third man
full just outside off. Driven down the ground to mid off
given plenty of air on a full length on off. Jadeja stretches forward and pokes it back to the bowler
length just outside off. Jadeja stays back and defends
googly flighted up full on leg stump. Moeen closes his bat face early and the ball rolls off the leading edge into the off side
full on middle and leg. Jadeja clears his front leg and swings it away towards deep backward square leg
flighted up very full on the stumps. Moeen drives it back to the bowler, who misfields and ends up conceding a single
floated up full outside off. Moeen comes forward and plays it back to the bowler
fullish outside off. Jadeja comes forward and pushes it towards mid off
wayward delivery well outside leg. An easy call for the umpire

huge appeal, and given! CSK lose another! Back of a length just outside off and this one does not bounce much. Mitchell is beaten by the lack of bounce and gets pinned on the knee roll of the front pad. The height might not be an issue but was it heading down leg with the angle? We go upstairs to find out. No bat involved, and Ball Tracking has the ball clipping the outside of leg stump. Very, very tight but it is Umpire's Call, and Mitchell has to go!
length outside off. Moeen presses half forward and punches on the up towards deep point
full just outside off. Mitchell plants his front foot and drives it down the ground to long off
very full outside off. Moeen throws his hands at it and slices it down to third man
fullish on middle and off. Mitchell comes forward and works it towards deep mid wicket

slower again, on a length on middle and leg. Mitchell brings out the reverse and helps it towards short third. The throw was wild but because Moeen had run so far past the stumps while completing the first, the second was not on

just evades Chahar! Googly on a back of a length on the stumps. Holds in the surface and spins away. Moeen pokes it uppishly and Chahar, despite a full-length dive to his left, cannot get his hands to it
tossed up full on off. Moeen lunges forward and smothers it
back of a length just outside off. Moeen taps it gently towards the bowler

two in two for Chahar! Back to back golden ducks for Shivam Dube, and CSK are now in disarray! Googly on a back of a length just outside off. Dube, while being caught on the crease, wafts at it and gets an outside edge that Jitesh pouches sharply. Chahar is off on his celebratory run, and these are two body blows in succession for CSK!

wicket first ball! A feather through to the keeper, and the Punjab Kings have the breakthrough they were after! Short and wide outside off, and Gaikwad will be gutted he has gotten out this way. He looks for the cut but the ball skids on just enough to outfox him. Smart catch by Jitesh behind the stumps, and that is a big moment in the game!
hard length, angling into off. Gaikwad stays leg side and dabs it towards short third
slower ball in the slot outside off. Mitchell plants his front foot and powers it to long off via Sam Curran's left hand. Very tough to call that a chance
slanted in full on the pads. Gaikwad advances and whisks it towards deep mid wicket. Gaikwad was intent on the second but Mitchell wasn't
full outside off. Mitchell sits back in his crease and knocks it to long off
slower ball bowled full outside off. Gaikwad comes forward and drives it towards long off
almost goes all the way! Marginally short on off. Seems to keep a touch low but Gaikwad manages to shovel it past deep mid wicket!
Mitchell ends the powerplay with a four! Angled into leg stump again, possibly aiming to tuck Mitchell up. He advances, swipes at it and squirts it between square leg and short fine!
very full on middle and off. Gaikwad might have been initially shaping for the sweep. Adjusts his stroke and pushes it to long off
make that three boundaries in four balls! Slowed up a little on a length on leg stump. Gaikwad gives himself ample room and caresses it over cover!
four more! Short and wide outside off. Gaikwad rocks onto the back foot and cuts it past the fielder at cover point. Not the greatest of efforts but CSK will not mind!
Gaikwad goes big! Fullish on leg stump. Not much air on this but Gaikwad manages to dance down the track. Gets close enough and eases it over mid on!
fired in and following the batter well outside leg. Gaikwad jabs it out towards cover point
off-pace on a back of a length on leg stump. Mitchell, despite backing away, does not have the room to free his arms and punches it on the bounce to mid off
back of a length on middle and leg. Mitchell gets inside the line and stabs it towards deep square leg. Puts on the stakes and hurtles back for two
shortish outside off. Gaikwad stays back and jabs it towards backward point for a sharpish single
gets the wide yorker right. Mitchell can only squeeze it out towards cover point
fuller but on the pads again. Mitchell works it to deep square leg's left and has enough time to saunter back for two
length ball on the pads. Gaikwad tucks it away towards deep square leg
back of a length just outside off. Gaikwad lets the ball come to him before patting it enough to cover's left for a single
another short ball on middle and off. Mitchell sizes it up and laces his pull. Cannot get it past deep square leg, though. Good work by Rossouw
into the blockhole on off. Mitchell jams his bat down in time and digs it out towards short extra cover
fuller and swinging into the batter on middle and leg. Mitchell pushes it down the ground to mid on
up and over! Back of a length outside off. Mitchell stands up on his toes, goes through the line and lofts it over mid off. Just clears the fence!
four to start the over! Banged in short outside off and this sits up nicely for Mitchell. He stands tall and hammers it to mid wicket's right!
short and wide outside off. Gaikwad has a loose poke at it away from his body and is lucky to not nick it through to Jitesh
follows the batter outside leg with a length ball. Gaikwad is cramped for room and taps it towards extra cover. He wanted the single but Mitchell was not interested
Gaikwad with his first boundary! Full on the pads and that is just what Gaikwad is waiting for. Transfers his weight forward and clips it over mid wicket!
very full on middle and leg. Mitchell tucks if off his toes towards deep square leg
shortish outside off. Gaikwad hops up onto his toes and dabs it down to third man
back of a length outside off. Mitchell throws his hands at it and slices it over extra cover. Plugs in the outfield a little and that allows Curran, running back from mid off, to rein it in
length ball on middle and leg. Mitchell, having taken a step down the track, nudges it into the square leg region to get off the mark

did that carry?! Very full and swinging into the pads. Rahane falls across and tries to dig it out. Flicks it towards mid wicket, who dives forward and snaffles it up. Rahane is not going anywhere, though. He thinks it is a bump ball, and there is some uncertainty over whether the catch was clean too. The ball clearly carried and Rabada did brilliantly to get his hands under it. Rahane has to go, and CSK have been rocked early!
fullish on middle and off. A hint of shape back into Gaikwad. He advances, bunts it to mid off and dashes across to the other end
length on middle and leg. Rahane presses forward and tucks it off his pads towards deep backward square leg
oh! Length just outside off. Goes on with the angle and Rahane, wafting at it, is beaten on the outside
shot! Full just outside off and Rahane pounces. Springs onto the front foot, shows the maker's name and cracks it back past the bowler!
similar length ball, just outside off. Gaikwad goes feeling for it again and chunks it off the inside edge. Hits him in an area where it usually hurts. Ouch...
length delivery honing into off stump. Gaikwad pokes at it tentatively and jams it off the inside edge into his pads
back of a length in the channel. Rahane waits for it and opens his bat face to run it down to third man
full just outside off. Rahane gets forward confidently and turns it between mid on and mid wicket for a couple of runs
angled in on a full length on middle and leg. Gaikwad tips it to mid on and hares across to the other end
fuller on off. Rahane comes forward and works it towards deep backward square leg to get off the mark
starts off with a wayward delivery down leg. Some early exercise for the umpire

the streak is over! CSK have come to Dharamsala and they have snapped their five-game losing run against the Punjab Kings! Bumper on middle and leg to finish off. Gets big on Brar and he can only splice it towards deep mid wicket. A bit of an anti-climactic end but CSK will be chuffed with the two points!
full toss outside off. Rabada throws his hands at it but mistimes it. Somehow he places it between extra cover and deep cover point and survives
banged in short outside off. Rabada swings at it (because he has no other option). Does not make any contact, though
four leg byes! Speared in full on the pads. Rabada is late on the flick but the ball squirms off the back leg, trickling into the fine leg fence eventually!
slower ball on a full length outside off. Rabada has a massive swish at it but only swishes at thin air
right up in the blockhole outside off. Brar can only squeeze it out towards long off
there is the first six! Half-tracker on middle and leg. Sits up nicely for Rabada and he climbs into it, hammering it over deep mid wicket!
full on off. Brar clears his front leg and drags it towards long on

hits the umpire! Right in the slot on middle and leg. Rabada backs away and smashes it back towards the bowler. The umpire cannot get out of the way in time and cops a blow on the body. All smiles, though, so no damage done
full on middle and off. Brar hangs back in his crease and flicks it towards long on
very full outside off. Rabada cannot get under it and clinks it towards long off

fuller but this is beyond the tramlines too. The difference is that Rabada did take a step across his stumps before letting it go. Called a wide, but Dhoni has asked Gaikwad to review this. Looks like Dhoni is right on this. The batter has moved across and the guideline has subsequently moved. It is within that new guideline and the decision has been overturned!
off-pace on a length well outside off. Outside the tramlines, and called a wide
short outside off. Rabada stands tall and pulls it on the bounce to long on
slower ball that goes awry and slides beyond the tramlines on the off side. Some more exercise for the umpire
length ball bowled way outside off. Brar throws himself at it and flays it towards deep cover point
full outside off. Rabada comes forward and drives it in languid fashion towards deep cover point

timbbeerrrrr! Speared in full on off stump. Chahar walks a mile across his stumps and gets too ambitious. Looks for the paddle but he is so far across that he cannot access the ball altogether. Fresh-air shot, and he hears the death rattle soon after!
shortish outside off. Brar stays deep in his crease and punches it towards deep point
Brar welcomes Shardul with a boundary! Short, wide and there to be punished. Brar waits on the slower one and crunches it past extra cover!
cutter on a length on middle and leg. Chahar has an agricultural swipe across the line and misses. The ball pings off his back thigh towards short third
takes the pace off and bowls it well outside off. Brar has to reach for it and cloths it to long off
sharp bumper on middle and leg. Brar opens up his stance and swings for the hills. Only swats away a few flies
what timing! Short outside off. Brar rises with the bounce, uses the pace and steers it delightfully to third man's left!
off-pace on a length on off. Chahar waits for it and plonks it towards backward point
dug into the track outside off. Brar scuffs it towards mid off and hares across to the other end
Chahar continues to make merry! Half-tracker on leg stump and this is not great bowling. Chahar steps inside the line and hooks it over fine leg!
shorter outside off and Chahar cannot catch up to it. Swishes at it because, well, why not, and the ball whizzes past the flailing blade
shot! Gleeson goes fuller but bowls it in the slot on off. Chahar gets his front foot out of the way and launches it over mid off!
streaky but PBKS will take those runs! Shortish outside off. Chahar continues swinging like a rusty gate and the ball flies off the top edge. Beats third man to his left!
back of a length outside off. Chahar winds up and tries to smash this into next week. Misses the ball comfortably
back of a length outside off. Chahar hops up onto his toes and dabs it towards backward point
dug into the track on middle and leg. Rears up on Brar and he has no option but to duck under it
full toss speared in at the stumps. Chahar, having walked across his stumps, whisks it away to deep square leg

Harshal falls to Simarjeet! Simarjeet sticks to the hard length, and Harshal continues to swing. The ball, though, gets big on Harshal and he cannot control the pull. Goes straight up and Rizvi does well to track it from mid wicket. Completes the catch in the square leg region, and that is the eighth nail hammered into the PBKS coffin!
four more! Back of a length outside off and the width is the issue here. Harshal can swish at it and the ball flies off the outside edge, beating third man to his left!
shot! Shortish outside off. Harshal, knowing that length is coming, shuffles across his stumps and paddles it over the keeper's head!
short and hung up outside off. Zips off the surface and Harshal is beaten for pace
back of a length outside off. Harshal throws his hands at it and flays it towards deep point. Just the one run off the over
peach! Back of a length on middle and off. Seams away against the angle and Harshal is opened up like a deck chair. Pokes at it but is beaten quite comprehensively
fullish just outside off. Harshal plants his front foot and drills it straight to mid off
short outside off again. Harshal has a big swish at this one but only connects with fresh air
shortish outside off. Harshal gets up on his toes and taps it gently towards backward point
hard length on middle and leg. Nips back in and Harshal jams it off the inside edge into his pads
full outside off. Harshal pushes it towards long off and gets off the mark
fuller and flatter on the stumps. Harshal plays it back to Jadeja
oh! Fizzed through on a length outside off. Grips in the surface and straightens, going past the outside edge

a massive yahoo across the line, and Ashutosh bites the dust! What is happening here in the Himalayan mountains?! Slowed up just a shade, and bowled on a length outside off. Ashutosh tries to smash it into the mountains and loses all shape. Skews off the outside edge and short third man does the rest. Dhoni applauds Jadeja's effort, and the whole of the CSK fan base will be applauding Jadeja's spell so far!
back of a length outside off. Brar stays back and jabs it towards deep cover point

taken this time! PBKS continue losing their way! Short and wide outside off. Curran, feeling the pinch of the run-rate and wanting to take on the left-arm spinner, swings at it. Laces it but does not get the requisite elevation. Straightforward catch to Santner at long off, and he was never going to drop that!

dropped, oh dear! That was a soda! Another sharp back of a length ball on off. Hurries Ashutosh all ends up and he tugs at it. Spoons it straight to Moeen at mid wicket, and he puts down an absolute sitter. Will that turn this game?
back of a length on off. Curran goes back and across before working it towards deep square leg
back of a length outside off. Curran hangs back in his crease and dabs it towards backward point
angled into the pads. Ashutosh tries to help it on its way but is late on the stroke. Deflects off the thigh pad for a leg bye
uff! Hard length just outside off. This one decks back in sharply and cuts Ashutosh in half. That was bowled at 145kph!
ouch! Hard length on middle and leg. Bowled at 140.9kh and this rushes onto Ashutosh. He misses his short-arm jab and gets pinged on the back hip
very full on middle and off. Ashutosh digs it out towards extra cover
short outside off. Curran stays back and cuts it towards extra cover

huge appeal, not given! Where did that pitch?! Fired in on a length. Finishes on leg stump and Curran plays all over it. The ball seems to be heading into the stumps but the ball might have pitched outside leg. Dhoni is not too convinced about the review and CSK do not go upstairs
full on the stumps again. Ashutosh punches it down the ground to long off
full on off again. Pushed out to short extra cover
full on middle and off. Ashutosh comes forward and plays it back to the bowler
banged into the track outside off. Curran, expecting it, is standing with his back foot outside off and swipes it towards long on
hard length on middle and off. Does not get up very high and Ashutosh, perhaps trying to duck under it, is caught in an awkward position. Fended away into the on side

First ball duck for Jitesh! Simarjeet into the act straightaway!Short and wide outside off. There to be hit and Jitesh goes after it. Throws his hands at it but cannot quite get on top of the bounce. Flies off the outside edge and Dhoni gobbles it up! Simarjeet is delighted, and PBKS in a bit of strife now!
sharp bumper on middle and leg that climbs onto Curran. He gets into an awkward tangle and fends it away towards fine leg
back of a length outside off. Curran gets up on his toes and jabs it towards backward point
hard length just outside off. Skids onto Curran and he can only hack it to short mid wicket

Prabhsimran perishes too! Jadeja slows this up, and bowls it full enough on the stumps to entice the lofted stroke. Prabhsimran needs no second invitation but the lack of pace means he cannot get the distance he is after. Arrows it straight to Rizvi at long off, and PBKS are four down!
full outside off. Driven crisply to the sweeper at deep cover point
fullish on middle and leg. Prabhsimran presses forward and pokes it past the bowler
back of a length on the pads. Prabhsimran goes back and glances it past short fine leg for a couple of runs
length on middle and leg. Curran knocks it down the ground to long on
full on middle and leg. Prabhsimran comes forward and flicks it towards long on

Santner gets Shashank! Throws up the bait outside off and Shashank takes it. Tries to make it back-to-back boundaries but this is slower than the previous ball. Shashank has to reach out and cloths it in the process. Chips it to Simarjeet at long on, who does the rest!
pristine stroke-making! In the slot just outside off. Shashank plants his front foot and bangs it over the bowler's head. One bounce and into the fence!
back of a length on off. Prabhsimran eases it down to long on
back of a length just outside off. Prabhsimran is caught on the crease and can only play it back to the bowler
back of a length on middle and leg. Shashank knocks it down the ground to long on
back of a length on middle and off. Shashank stays back and pushes it towards extra cover
shot! Darted in on leg stump. Prabhsimran backs away early, which creates room and then carves it past extra cover. Mitchell at long off had no chance either!
length outside off. Shashank gets a half stride in and knocks it to long off
length on middle and leg. Shashank comes forward and defends
fired down leg. Prabhsimran paddles it towards short fine leg for a single
slanted into the pads. Shashank turns it towards deep mid wicket
safe! Floated up full outside off. Shashank has a massive swing at it and slices it. Luckily for him, it lands in front of long off, who was running to his left
angled in on a fullish length on off. Shashank works it towards mid wicket and calls for the single. Completed comfortably enough
four more! Another half-volley outside off and that is fodder for Shashank. Shashank goes through the line and lofts it over mid off!
cutter on a length outside off. Prabhsimran comes forward and drops it into the off side
low full toss on middle and leg. Prabhsimran flicks it straight to mid on

smart batting! Prabhsimran runs down the track and that prompts Deshpande to bowl it short at his body. The batter, though, is waiting for it. Arches his back to create room and glides it over short third!
pick the bones out of this one! Slower ball on a length outside off. Prabhsimran picks it, marches out of his bunker and pounds it a mile over long on!
full toss outside off. Takes Shashank by surprise and he can only push it towards cover point

just over! Back of a length outside off. Shashank takes a step down the track and goes after it. Chunks it off the inside half of the bat but manages to clear Santner at mid wicket. Santner tears after it and saves two
back of a length on middle and leg. Prabhsimran works it towards mid wicket for a single
almost into the second tier! Half-tracker on leg stump and that is not great bowling. Prabhsimran gets inside the line and swings it away over fine leg!
length just outside off. Shashank presses half forward and stabs it towards mid on
over the top! Shortish outside off and there is just too much width on offer. Shashank walks down the track and flays it over point!
short down leg. Shashank does not make contact and called a wide by the umpire
beauty! Length in the channel just outside off. Decks away against the angle and Prabhsimran, who pokes at it, is all at sea
back of a length on the pads. Shashank tucks it away towards deep backward square leg and both batters are content with a single
another play and miss! Back of a length outside off. This shapes away in the air and beats Shashank on the outside as he goes chasing after it
oh! Back of a length outside off, bowled at 137.8kph. Seams off the surface and fizzes past Shashank's bat as he wafts at it
back of a length outside off. Shashank presses half forward and defends
shot! Goes full, looking for movement but ends up bowling a half-volley. Shashank gets his hands through the ball and lofts it over mid off!
full outside off. Shashank comes onto the front foot and eases it out to long off
length delivery on the pads. Prabhsimran glances it towards short fine leg and gets across to the other end
back of a length ball that starts outside off and curves back in. Prabhsimran, rather hurriedly, stabs it out into the off side
follows the batter outside leg with a length ball. Prabhsimran pats it towards extra cover
angled in on a length on middle and leg. Prabhsimran, without really getting forward or going back, prods it towards Santner
short and wide outside off. Prabhsimran cuts it straight to extra cover

hot knife through butter! Back of a length delivery that pitches on leg and nips away. Keeps a smidgen low and Rossouw, like he has done all innings, is trapped on the crease. Wafts at it and watches in disbelief as the ball whizzes past and pummels off stump!
length just outside off. Rossouw hangs back and defends
full just outside off. Rossouw comes half forward and taps it towards extra cover, who picks it up cleanly and has a shy at the stumps at the bowler's end. Prabhsimran had to scramble to make it back

cleans him up, and Deshpande is absolutely pumped! Back of a length delivery that pitches just outside off and decks back sharply. Bairstow does not account for that much movement and pokes at it tentatively. Goes past the bat, richochets off the pads and crashes into off stump. Just the start CSK would have wanted!
inside edge now! Length outside off. Bairstow has an ugly hack at it and squirts it away towards short fine leg
goes through! Length on off. Pitches and straightens a shade. Bairstow has a stab at it and gets an outside edge that goes between Dhoni and short third!
sprays this down leg first up. Bairstow does not get bat on it and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide
pushed into the batter on a back of a length on middle and leg. Prabhsimran prods it towards mid on
darted in on a hard length on middle and leg. Bairstow taps it towards extra cover
slower and shorter outside off. Holds in the surface and straightens just enough to take it past the outside edge of Bairstow's flailing blade
back of a length, angled into middle and leg. Bairstow goes back and jabs it towards cover
conventional delivery, on a length on off. Prabhsimran pushes it into the off side and gets off the mark
almost! Length ball outside off that swerves back in sharply. Prabhsimran has a swish at it and chunks it off the inside edge into his pads
